_source: Built from Ollama's own documentation (read 2026-10-20). success is the documented response example of https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/web-search verbatim, with each item's title, url and content. empty is a results array with no items, built from the same documented schema (Ollama shows no empty example). malformed is a 200 without results, the only documented top-level field. Error bodies use the documented error format of https://docs.ollama.com/api/errors ({"error": "..."}) for the statuses that page lists (400, 404, 429, 500, 502); their messages are illustrative, since none is documented for web search. 401 and 403 are the statuses Ollama's cloud usage reference (https://docs.ollama.com/api/cloud-usage) documents for invalid credentials and a suspended account, with the same error body. rate_limited carries no Retry-After, as none is documented for web search; rate_limited_retry carries the Retry-After the cloud usage reference documents for its own 429 and checks that one is honoured if sent.
